name: Yandere Escape
original_name: ヤンデレ・エスケープ
source:
"I would drench my hands in blood to protect you."

"I will spend my money to have you in my hands."

This is a game of romance with yandere who have authority and power in their hands.
Will you be able to escape from their poisonous fangs?
